home3_all.nullDescription: Shuffle choices across games while preserving total underdog/favorite counts. Outcome-blind features: market spread magnitude, market favorite is home, FBS-vs-FCS. Ridge penalty 1; exact leave-one-out predictions; balanced accuracy averages favorite and underdog recall. Covariate scaling uses the entire fixed design matrix, never game outcomes.
